device_entry.name: Picomotor 微位移电机控制器
category: 压电步进位移台控制器
tags: 样品/探针定位与运动控制
压电步进位移台控制器
device_entry.description: 这是一种用于驱动和控制 Picomotor 微位移执行器的运动控制器，通常通过 USB 与计算机连接。它常用于实验室中的精密光学调整、镜架或平台的微小位移调节，以及需要高分辨率机械定位的场景。
device_entry.description_en: This is a motion controller for driving and controlling Picomotor micro-positioning actuators, typically connected to a computer via USB. It is commonly used in laboratories for fine optical alignment, small displacement adjustment of mounts or stages, and other applications requiring high-resolution mechanical positioning.

schema.description: 向控制器发送一条 USB 命令，可选读取返回数据。
schema.description_en: Send a USB command to the controller, optionally reading back a reply.

schema.description: 将 New Focus 风格命令解析并转换为控制器可接收的 USB 命令格式。
schema.description_en: Parse a New Focus-style command and convert it into a USB command format accepted by the controller.

schema.description: 解析控制器返回的数据并转换为可读文本。
schema.description_en: Parse the controller reply and convert it into human-readable text.

schema.description: 向控制器发送一条标准命令，并在查询命令时返回解析后的响应。
schema.description_en: Send a standard command to the controller and return the parsed response for query commands.

schema.description: 启动交互式控制台，连续输入并发送控制器命令。
schema.description_en: Start an interactive console for continuously entering and sending controller commands.
